name: Ko Kaeo
intro: Ko Kaeo is a residential subdistrict on Phuket's east side, between Phuket Town and Thalang. It is home to marinas, large housing estates, international schools and a mainly Thai and long-stay community, away from the tourist beaches.
overview:
Ko Kaeo is on the eastern side of Mueang Phuket district, away from the west-coast beaches. Project descriptions point to the Boat Lagoon marina area, schools such as the British International School and Finnway, and hospitals as the main nearby destinations; one villa development states that it is not within walking distance of a beach.
Our three projects here are villas and townhouses, with a mix of off-plan and completed developments.
suitableFor: Families with children at nearby international schools
highlights: Boat Lagoon and Royal Phuket Marina
Close to Phuket Town and Central Phuket

photos.author: Roma Neus

lifestyle: Ko Kaeo is practical and residential, with supermarkets, international schools, marinas and easy access to Phuket Town's hospitals and shopping.
beaches: Ko Kaeo is on the east coast, which has mangroves and marinas rather than swimming beaches. The west-coast beaches are about 20 to 30 minutes away by car.
rentalMarket: Ko Kaeo is a long-term rental market. Tenants are mainly families with children at nearby schools, boat owners and professionals working in Phuket Town.

rentalDetails.title: Long-term rentals
rentalDetails.text: Families and professionals look for houses and villas with gardens close to schools.

rentalDetails.title: Short-term holiday rentals
rentalDetails.text: Limited, because there is no beach nearby.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: steady residential demand. Limitations: little holiday demand and far from the west-coast beaches.

investment: Ko Kaeo suits buyers who want a family home or a long-term rental near schools, marinas and Phuket Town rather than a holiday property.

investmentDetails.title: Risks to consider
investmentDetails.text: Lower rental prices than tourist areas; many housing estates compete.

investmentDetails.title: Ownership costs
investmentDetails.text: Maintenance, estate fees, insurance and periods between tenants.

faq.question: Where is Ko Kaeo in Phuket?
faq.answer: Ko Kaeo is a subdistrict on the east side of the island, north of Phuket Town and south of Thalang.

faq.question: Are there beaches in Ko Kaeo?
faq.answer: No swimming beaches; the east coast here has mangroves and marinas. The west-coast beaches are about 20 to 30 minutes away.

faq.question: Is Ko Kaeo good for families?
faq.answer: Yes, many families live here because of the international schools, supermarkets and housing estates.

faq.question: Which marinas are in Ko Kaeo?
faq.answer: Boat Lagoon and Royal Phuket Marina are both in Ko Kaeo.

faq.question: How far is Ko Kaeo from the airport?
faq.answer: Our project data gives about 22 to 25 km to Phuket International Airport.
